desc: Build adjacency lists for the original graph and its reverse, so moves from flipped states can be simulated without actually mutating edges.
Implement Dijkstra over states `(vertex, parity)` with distance array size `2 * (N + 1)`, initialized to infinity and source `(1, 0)` with distance 0.
Add transitions: for parity 0, follow original edges `u -> v` with cost 1; for parity 1, follow reversed edges `v -> u` with cost 1.
Add the toggle transition from `(v, p)` to `(v, 1-p)` with cost X, using a large (arbitrary-precision) distance value, and skip stale priority-queue entries.
Compute and output `min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1])`, verified against all four provided samples.
